# Todd Abbott appointed as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer


October 19, 2026 8:30am EDT[Download as PDF](https://ir.tamboran.com/_assets/_5321a7ac6bc23c6b49ffdf6a0dce1abf/tamboran/news/2026-10-19_Todd_Abbott_appointed_as_Managing_Director_and_50.pdf)


**Highlights**


- **Mr. Todd Abbott has been appointed as Managing Director of Tamboran Resources Corporation, in addition to his role as Chief Executive Officer, effective today.**
- **Mr. Abbott has more than 25 years of upstream oil and gas experience spanning unconventional shale operations, strategy, infrastructure, business planning and corporate finance.**
- **The appointment follows Mr. Abbott’s appointment as Chief Executive Officer in January 2026 and formalizes his executive leadership at the Board level as the Company moves from the appraisal phase into development.**


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- **Tamboran Resources Corporation (NYSE: TBN, ASX: TBN):**


**Tamboran Resources Chair, Richard Stoneburner, said:**


“The Board is pleased to appoint Todd as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer as Tamboran advances its strategy of supplying natural gas from the Beetaloo Basin to the Northern Territory, Australia’s East Coast and Asia Pacific gas markets.


“Todd brings more than two decades of upstream experience with a strong record of safety, operational and strategic leadership and capital discipline. We look forward to Todd continuing to lead the Company through its next phase of growth.”


**Tamboran Resources Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, Todd Abbott, said:**


“It is an honor to be appointed Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Tamboran, and I thank the Board for its continued support.


“This appointment comes at an exciting and transformative time for the Company. The last few months have been a pivotal period for Tamboran and the Beetaloo Basin, highlighted by the achievement of first gas sales from the Beetaloo to the Northern Territory gas market.


“I look forward to leading Tamboran through our next phase of growth, as we move from the de-risking phase into the development of this world-class asset.”


The material terms of Mr. Abbott’s appointment are unchanged and are set out in the ASX announcement released on January 12, 2026.


***This announcement was approved and authorized for release by the Board of Tamboran Resources Corporation.***


**About Tamboran Resources Corporation**


Tamboran Resources Corporation (NYSE/ASX: TBN) is a growth-driven independent natural gas exploration and production company. Tamboran is focused on an integrated approach to the commercial development of the natural gas resources in the Beetaloo Basin located within the Northern Territory of Australia. Through its subsidiaries, Tamboran holds approximately 2.8 million net prospective acres and is the largest acreage holder in the Beetaloo Basin depocenter.
